foundations: the canonical Action chain has tenant-scoped Proposal, Approval, ExecutionLease, immutable initial Receipt, unknown without blind retry, provider reread reconcile and compensation Proposal foundations
one generic Action Proposal binds one actionType revision and the current service enforces maker, approver and executor separation plus expiry, kill and basic budget/rate guards
the frontend differentiates approved, leased, executing, applied, failed, unknown and reconciled states and disables disconnected writes
the reviewed W6-03 target contract separates side-effect-free OutreachBatch prepare/freeze from W6-04 explicit start

findings.finding: W6-03 has no implemented OutreachBatchRevision or frozen eligible item set, so W6-04 has no valid batch authority to start.
outreach.send, sample.ship, contract.accept and commission.change are absent from the current SolutionPack and action authority; ecommerce.creator-growth permissions.actionTypes is empty.
no domain policy/compiler proves that one approval and Lease are confined to one of the four creator capabilities, one account binding, one item set, one budget and one ImpactPreview.
no OutreachBatch start command, version CAS, start decision, start Receipt or exact revalidation of frozen Brief/Evidence/Eval/Responsibility/Match/Frequency/Capacity refs exists.

the generic ActionAdapter executes one arbitrary payload and returns a single outcome; no per-item Action/Receipt mapping, accepted/pending/failed/unknown conservation or batch partial reducer exists.

the production ActionAdapter registry has no registered creator messaging, shipment, contract or commission adapter and the generic contract lacks typed input/output, trusted account, usage and webhook conformance.
the current executor commits Lease consumption and Proposal executing before calling the provider; a process crash in that window leaves no durable attempt/initial Receipt and prevents a safe retry.
generic reconcile records top-level status reconciled while placing applied/failed only in payload, has no manual Case for missing provider refs and no creator batch/item roll-up semantics.

ContractRef, DeliveryRef and RelationshipRevision exist only as requiredObjects strings; no controlled reference validation, clause Diff, commission maker-checker, delivery observation, maturity window, store, API or lineage projection is implemented.
only the generic Draft Inbox and common Workshop shell exist; the creator module has no item-level partial/unknown timeline, contract Diff, delivery or long-term relationship read model.
W5-00 through W5-08 are all unchecked and production adapter registrations remain zero, so no creator external capability is code-green or operational-ready.

verification.interpretation: generic single-action safety and UI foundations are stable, while creator batch start, per-item partial accounting, four independent operational capabilities and contract/delivery/relationship authorities are absent
